skills.guidance_used: Radical minimalism, standard library over custom code, minimal DTOs, direct typed calls over repository layers, no speculative GraphQL or KMP networking.
skills.reason: Prevents enterprise architectural sprawl and over-engineering.

skills.guidance_used: Unit tests for DTO decoding, MockWebServer for testing HTTP contract parsing, error envelopes, and timeouts.
skills.guidance_rejected: Robolectric or instrumented tests for simple DTO decoding.
skills.reason: JVM unit tests with MockWebServer are fast, deterministic, and verify exact HTTP contracts.

skills.guidance_used: Ensured no sensitive API configurations or internal endpoints exposed via exported components.
skills.reason: Keeps network layer purely internal to app package.

skills.guidance_used: HTTPS-only enforcement; no cleartext HTTP traffic allowed; no user location or sensitive data transmitted without explicit consent.
skills.reason: Adheres to Google Play Network Security and Data Safety requirements.

skills.guidance_used: Native URLSession with async/await, URLRequest configuration, URLProtocol-based unit testing, status code validation, explicit timeoutInterval, no Alamofire.
skills.guidance_rejected: Third-party networking libraries (Alamofire, Moya), complex delegate-based background session managers.
skills.reason: URLSession async/await is native, robust, and zero-dependency in iOS 17+.

skills.guidance_used: Safe decoding strategies, robust enum decoding with unknown fallbacks, nullable optional properties, snake_case key remapping.
skills.guidance_rejected: Force unwrapping, throwing on unknown enum cases.

skills.guidance_used: Async/await patterns, Task cancellation handling, Sendable conformance for DTOs and network configuration.
HTTPS enforcement, ATS compliance, no logging of credentials or personal data.
skills.reason: Pinning introduces operational risk for API endpoints without active rotation automation.

skills.guidance_used: Codebase relationship verification and AST update post-modification.
skills.guidance_rejected: Full LLM extraction during local iteration.
skills.reason: Keeps graph consistent without API cost.
